summary: You get fewer and clearer alert emails.

fixes.title: The same drift is not emailed repeatedly
fixes.text: An unchanged drift report is sent once, then at most daily while it lasts. A change is sent at once; repeated identical job failures work the same way.

fixes.title: Drift reports name what they found
fixes.text: An Azure assignment that PIM Manager does not manage is now reported with the account or group and the role, instead of a blank.

fixes.title: Duplicate Defender XDR roles are cleaned up
fixes.text: When Defender XDR answered slowly, a custom role could be created twice. PIM Manager now waits for it and removes its own unused extra copy; your roles are never removed.
